chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and Hammad ibn 'Uthman from 'Ubaydillah al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the Eid prayer according to the narrations of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, confirms the jurisprudential ruling for the Eid prayers through two distinct chains of transmission, emphasizing the reliability of the report via the prominent narrator Hisham ibn al-Hakam. The notation 'Like it' (mithluhu) indicates that this narration serves as a corroborating parallel to the preceding text, reinforcing the established legal precedent for the performance of these communal prayers. This redundancy is characteristic of Shia hadith compilation, ensuring the robustness of the ruling against variations in transmission.
